content: 'Ũyũmmũg. 'Ũtak 'ũm yõg hãpxop xohix, tu' xok putup, hak-hãy tuk-tok te' pop putup, 'ũyõg 'ãtak yõg hãpxop pop putup. Pa' xip 'ãtak, hak-tok 'ũhok, yã' hok hã' hãm yãy tak pu'. 'Ũyõg 'ãtak te' popmã'ax hãpxop, yãk-tok yõg hãpxop, tu' pop putup, pa hõnhã' pop'ah. Yã hõnhã hãmhõgnãg 'ũk-tok.

Ha ta' xuxyã te nõm kutok xat, nũy tu pẽnã max, ha ta' xuxyã nõy te hãpxop pẽnãnã' xip, nõm hãpxop 'ãtak tek-tok pu' popmã'ax, yã nõm tek-tok pẽnãhã', tu hãpxop pẽnãhã', tu mõktu nõm 'ãmnĩy 'ũm mõ'nãhã', yã tik yõg 'ãtak te nõm 'ãmnĩy 'ãktux tap.

Hã kaxĩy yũmũg mũn hõmã kamah. Yã yũmũ'ãte nõm kutok putuk, ha yãmĩy kummuk xop te yũmũg xat kummuk, ha nõm xop pu yũmũ'ãte' hok hã' hãpxopmãhã' yãmĩy xop pu', xix Topa hã' puknõg xop pu yũmũ'ãte hãpxopmãhã'.

Pa hãpxip 'ĩhã nõm hãptup mõ'nãhã', 'ĩhã Topa te yãy kutok pit nũ'kutnãhã', ha' tut te' put, yã Yoneo xop kopa' xip Topak-tok, ha ta Mõyyex yõg xat'ax xohix xexka pu' yĩpkox xip Topak-tok, nũnte hãm xexka tu' xip 'ĩhã'.
Topak-tok nũn, nũy nõkõpanat yũmũg xohix, puyĩy Mõyyex yõg xat'ax yũmũg xat hok, tu' nũn, nũy yũmũg kuxa hĩnnã xe'ẽgnãg, 'ũyĩy yũmũg xohix yãyhã Topak-tok xop.
Yã 'ãxop yã Topak-tok xop, yĩy ta Topa te nũ'kutnãhã yãy Koxuk 'ãkuxa hah, ha Topa Koxuk te Topa pu: “'Ãtak, yõgnũ 'ãtak!” Kaxĩy.
Hamũn, yã hõnhã' kux, 'ãxop te 'a hok hã 'ãhãm'ah, pa nõmhã 'ãxop yã Topak-tok, ha Topa te xa' popmãp-tup yãy yõg hãpxop, yã yãy kutok pu nõm popmãp-tup.
Paot kuxãnõg. 'Ok Ganax yõg xop kuxa mãm kux?
Pãyã hõmã 'ãxop te Topa hã 'ãpuknõg, ha ta topa komut xop te 'ãxop xat pax, tu yã mõ'ãmã'.

Pa nõmhã 'ãxop te Topa yũmmũg, yã Topa te 'ãxop yũmmũg hãmãxap, hak-nãy tu 'ãxop te Topa yũmmũg. Texĩy tu putpu 'ãxop mõg, nũy Topa hã' puknõg xop yõg hãpxopmã'ax tat 'ũxeheh? Nõm hãpxopmã'ax te 'ãxop hã te 'ohnãg. Yã 'ãkummugã'ax 'ũxeheh.
Yã 'ãxat, xa nit xãn 'ĩhã 'ãhãm hok, tu 'ãmuk xexka mĩy'ax xat, xix mãyõnhex tup'ax yõg 'ãmuk xat, xix mõ'ãgmũ'ax yõg, xix hãmyãxatamuk yõg.
'Ũgkuxãnõg. 'Ok hitop hãg hãm 'ũgmũn 'ãxop kopah? 'Ok 'ãkuxa mãm kux, nũy nõ xat'ax hittap mĩy?
'Ũkxape xop, 'ãpu yõg hãpxopmã'ax tat. Yã 'ãxop hãgxape, yãg kummugã 'ohnãg.
Xatek yũmmũg, hõmã 'ũkpakut, 'ihã noxk xip 'ãxop mũtik, hu 'ãte Topa yõg hãm'ãpak max'ax 'ãktux hãmãxap 'ãxop pu'.
'Ũkpakut xexka', pa 'ãxop tek putup pax, tuk mũn tu yãyhãhup 'ohnãg, tuk kuxa ka', tu 'ãhãk tehe', tuk hã' tot, yã pexkox nũ'pok xop putuk, yã Yeyox Kunnix putuk,
ha 'ãxop tek mũn hã 'ãhittup xexka'! Hamũn, hõmã 'ãxop tek mũn hã 'ãhittup xexka', pa hõmhã 'ãmhõk. Texĩy?
'Ok 'ãte xa hãpxe'e 'ãktux, hu yãyhã 'ãxop hãk puknõg? Pa tĩy! 'Ok 'ãhãg puknõg nõmhã?
Yã nõm xop te 'ãp-tup pax 'ãktux, nũy 'ãxop mõgã, pãyã yõg putat ka'ax kummuk, tu yũmũg yãy xatat putup, 'ãxop xik mũn, xayĩy nõm pe 'ãmõg.
Ta' max, pu nõm xop 'ãp-tup pax. Tikmũ'ũn te' nõy putup pax, tu hãpxopmã max, 'ĩhã 'ãxop mũtik xip, 'ãxop mũtik xip hok kamah. 'Ãte xa hãpxe'e 'ãktux.
'Ũgkutok xop, 'ũgkuxa xũy, yã' tut tek-tok put xũy putuk. Hã kaxĩy 'ãte 'ãxop hãg kuxa xũy, ha mõktu 'ãxop yãyhã Kunnix putuk.
'Ãtep-tup, nũy noxk xip 'ãxop mũtik nõmhã, nũy 'õg hãmpe tu panõm hã' nõy yãnãn. 'Ũgkuxãnõg. 'A 'ãxop yõg hãpxopmã'ax max'ah.
Tu 'Agah xix Xat 'ãktux
'Ãpu, 'ã hãm'ãktux! 'Ãxop tep-tup, nũy Moyyex yõg xat'ax mĩy, nũy yãy kuxa tupmã Topa pu'. Mõyyex yõg xat'ax tep-tep 'ãktux?

'Ũxuktux kaxĩy: Yã mõnãyxop 'Amanãm kutok 2. 'Ũk-tok puxet mũg tut yã' hok hã' hãm, yã' nõy te' xat, ha' hok hã' hãm, yã' puknõg. Pak-tok nõy mũg tut yã 'ũn xe'ẽgnãg, 'ap hok hã' hãm'ah, pãyã kãmãnat xat.
Ha 'Ũn yã' hok hã' hãm, tuk-tok pit put, yã kaxĩy 'ũn xohix tek-tok put. Pa 'ũn nõy yã' nõy xat, tuk-tok pit put, ha hãmhũmnãg 'ũnã'ax, ha Topa te hãm'ãktux xex, tu kakxop putnãhã'.

Hamũn te yũmũ'ã hãmyũmmũgãhã' hãpxopmã'ax nõy. 'Ũn 2 te hãpxopmã'ax yũmmũgãhã', Topa te' pa'ax mĩy tikmũ'ũn mũtik. 'Ũn puxet yã' hok hãm. Yã' xuxet'ax 'Agah, ha 'ũn nõy te 'Agah xat. Hã kaxĩy Topa te tikmũ'ũn xat, tu' xat'ax xohix popmãhã yĩktix Xĩnãy tu', hã kaxĩy 'Ãgah hã' mõkputox, yã' hok hã' hãm, tu' yãy xat 'ohnãg.
Yĩktix Xinãy xip 'Anap tu', tu' yõg tikmũ'ũn yã' hok hã' hãm, xix kõmẽn Yenoyanẽn yõg tikmũ'ũn yã' hok hã' hãm. Nõm xop te 'Agah mõkputox putuk.
Ha ta' xip kõmẽn Yenoyanãn nõy, tu pepi' xup pexkox tu'. Nõm yõg tikmũ'un te yãy xat, 'ap hok hã' hãm'ah, nõm kõmẽn yũmũ'ã hã' tut xe'e'.
Yĩy Topa yõg tappet te:

content.text: Yã tik te' xetut nĩm, hak-tok xohix punethok.
Ha tik te' xetut mũtik nõm, hak-tok kutõgnãg.” Kaxĩy.

content: Hõmã Topa te hãm'ãktux xex 'Amanãm pu', yĩ' xetut Xat tek-tok 'Iyak put. 'Ũkxape xop, hã kaxĩy yũmũg yãyhã Topak-tok xop, Topa te hãm'ãktux xex hah.

Yã hõmã 'Amanãm kutok puxet, pa Topa te nõm hãmãxap hã hãm'ãktux xex 'ohnãg. Ha tak-nãy tu' nõy put, ha Topa Koxuk te nõm hã hãm'ãktux xex, hak-tok te mãxap te' taknõy tek-te'ex kummuk. Yã hã kaxĩy hõnhã kamah.

Putep xuktux Topa yõg tappet? Yã hãm'ãktux, hu: “'Ãpu' xat pu mõg, 'ũn te' hok hã' hãm, xik-tok. Hãmũn, yã 'ãtak te yãy yõg hãpxop popmãp-tup'ah nõm 'ũn kutok pu', pãyãk-tok nõy pu' popmãp-tup, tu yãy xetut xe'ek-tok pu' popmãp-tup.” Kaxiy.
Yĩy ta 'ũkxape xop, yũmũg mũn yã' xetut xe'e hãk kutok xop, nõm te' nõy xat. 'Ap 'ũn nõy hã yũmũg kutok 'ohnãg, nõm te' hok hã' hãm. 'Ãmhok.
